name: xgo-relocatable-deep-node-clones
instr:
Provide relocatable deep cloning for ordinary and XGo syntax, parser package graphs, gopq views, compiler inputs, and template syntax, so callers can transform copies without reparsing or affecting their sources. Clones must remain behaviorally interchangeable with their originals for traversal, compilation, formatting, matching, and diagnostics until independently mutated.

Cloning is transactional: success returns an independent graph and deterministic report, while any position-mapping or unsupported-node failure leaves the complete source graph and its wrappers unchanged. Every clone preserves graph topology, shared-reference relationships, optional children, explicit versus implicit identifier semantics, XGo metadata, and traversal order, while translating positions and exposing no original mutable nodes. Object preservation follows `CloneOptions.PreserveObjects`, and cloned gopq adapters expose only objects from the cloned package, file, declaration, statement, and specification graphs. In `github.com/goplus/xgo/ast/gopq`, `Node.Clone(opts)` returns `(Node, ast.CloneReport, error)`, while `NodeSet.Clone(opts)` returns `NodeSet`, preserves existing errors without traversal, and carries clone failures as its error.
